rationale: The persona is strongly phenomenon-first and driven by open questions, which fits the direct test in option 1: does hacking emerge when it is not rewarded? Option 2 splits the budget across unhackable environments and large realistic pipelines, which adds scope and realism concerns this researcher usually handles with narrower, controlled setups. Option 1 is not fully controlled, since it relies on whatever environments are available, so the lean is moderate rather than decisive.
